source_reference: HELIOS legacy spec sheet v0.3, section 2
title: 15m wick-rejection reversal, restated from a legacy spec sheet
notes: Restated during migration. The legacy sheet carried no thresholds of its own.
excerpt: Signal fires on a large 15m rejection wick.
text: Signal fires on a large 15m rejection wick, followed by a bar that closes beyond the opposite extreme of that bar. Evaluate on 15m bar close. Direction is SHORT after an upper wick and LONG after a lower wick.
